attributes.board_name: Georgia Composite Board of Professional Counselors, Social Workers, and Marriage & Family Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Core hours (min 15) from professional associations, academic departments or other jurisdictions' licensing boards in the licensee's own specialty (graduate coursework max 20 h); related hours (max 15) from counseling, social work, MFT or allied-field associations/departments, other boards, government agencies and licensed hospitals; independent study max 5 h
rules.new_licensee_rule: A license first issued in the second year of a cycle needs no CE for its first renewal.
rules.audit_note: The Board audits a percentage of renewals; audited licensees submit the CE Audit Reporting Form with documentation. Keep CE records 4 years.

topics.who: Before providing TeleMental Health (9 h incl. 3 h on supervising TeleMental Health before supervising it); counts toward the 35 h

rules.notes: Max 10 hours asynchronous per cycle; max 20 hours from any single course or presentation (except multi-session conferences). Cycle runs Oct 1 of an even year to Sep 30 of the next even year; applies to associate licenses too.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Thirty-five (35) hours of continuing education are required to be obtained within the two (2) year biennial licensure cycle to renew each license, including associate level licenses.
